purpose.domain_detail: Credit card transaction reporting: reads card transaction records and produces separate reports for Visa, Mastercard, JCB, and an all-cards combined file with totals
purpose.summary: Batch program that reads a flat file of credit card transactions (card number, amount, MDR, VAT, card type) and writes them to four separate output report files categorized by card type (Visa, Mastercard, JCB, and all). It prints paginated reports with headers and summary totals per card type and grand totals.

No COMP-3 usage despite financial amounts
